title: Rear Admiral Gallaudet researching underwater anomalies
summary: Ryan Graves tells of Rear Admiral Gallaudet researching underwater anomalies, about present at NOAA / oceans, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I know Rear Admiral Tim Galidet uh who used to run uh Noah National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association is highly interested in these underwater anomalies.

plain: A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy rear admiral who once helped run NOAA, the US government agency for oceans and weather, is very interested in strange objects reported underwater. If true, it would mean a senior ocean official takes such reports seriously.
